# telnyx_enterprise_reputation_numbers_refresh (Action)

Collects fresh reputation data for an enterprise's monitored numbers now. Telnyx bills each refresh.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enterprise_id` (String) The enterprise id.
- `phone_numbers` (List of String) Phone numbers to refresh reputation data for. 1–100 numbers per request, each in E.164 format. Reputation refreshes are subject to per-enterprise rate limits.
